tickets.name: Scale app cluster before traffic spike
tickets.blurb: Marketing has a campaign running in 5 minutes. App cluster at tier 1 has 300 rps headroom. The spike will bring 1,200 rps. Upgrade to tier 2 (1,500 rps) before it hits or you'll be throttling paying customers.

tickets.name: App cluster at capacity — needs tier 3
tickets.blurb: Last month's traffic spike hit 4,000 rps. App cluster tier 2 peaks at 1,500 rps. You need tier 3 (8,000 rps) before the annual product event, which historically generates 3x normal traffic for 90 minutes.

tickets.name: Load balancer becoming a bottleneck
tickets.blurb: The load balancer is approaching its connection limit under current traffic. At current growth rates, it will saturate in 8 ticks. Tier 2 increases capacity 10x and adds health check routing.

tickets.name: Database query latency SLA at risk
tickets.blurb: Database query latency is approaching the p95 SLA threshold. Tier 2 doubles query capacity and adds a read replica. The latency SLA is 200ms; you're currently at 180ms on busy days.

tickets.name: CDN tier 1 can't absorb launch traffic
tickets.blurb: The CDN is serving 8,000 rps on peak days. Tier 1 capacity is 10,000 rps — you have 20% headroom. The product launch brings 50,000 rps. Without tier 2, the CDN saturates and traffic hits your origin directly.

tickets.name: Cache hit rate falling — tier 1 at capacity
tickets.blurb: Cache hit rate has been falling. The tier-1 Redis instance is at 90% capacity during peak hours. Tier 2 triples throughput and reduces latency under load. The customer success team is starting to notice the slowdowns.

tickets.name: Deploy replaces need a hot standby
tickets.blurb: The team is deploying a schema migration this sprint. Engineering requires a hot standby before they merge — if the migration fails, you need to roll back in under 2 minutes. No replica means no deploy window.

tickets.name: On-call insists on autoscaling before deploy
tickets.blurb: The deployment team won't merge the new service until autoscaling is enabled. The last deployment caused a 45-minute incident when traffic spiked 3x and the team had to manually scale. Enable autoscaling first.

tickets.name: Backup before major schema migration
tickets.blurb: Schema migration is scheduled for next deploy window. The DBA requires a verified backup before the migration runs. If the migration corrupts data, the backup is the only recovery path.

tickets.name: SLA contract requires multi-AZ for Tier 1 customers
tickets.blurb: Your SLA contract with enterprise customers specifies 99.95% uptime. A single-AZ deployment cannot mathematically guarantee that. The enterprise renewals are next quarter. Migrate to multi-AZ now.

tickets.name: Disaster recovery drill scheduled
tickets.blurb: A disaster recovery drill is scheduled. The scenario: primary region goes offline. SRE lead needs to verify that DR procedures exist before the drill. Having backup_system on the board is the prerequisite.

tickets.name: Security audit: database must be encrypted at rest
tickets.blurb: Security audit is next week. Auditor checklist item 3.2: database must have encryption at rest enabled. A failed audit item blocks the SOC 2 certification. Engineering has three weeks to pass.

tickets.name: DDoS protection required for PCI scope
tickets.blurb: The API is in scope for PCI DSS compliance. PCI requirement 6.4: rate limiting must be in place on all external-facing endpoints. The QSA audit is in 35 ticks. A failed audit item means the company cannot process card payments.

tickets.name: GDPR compliance: enable audit logging on database
tickets.blurb: GDPR compliance requires audit logging on all databases that store personal data. Your postgres instance stores user accounts. The DPO has set a 30-day deadline. Postgres tier 4 enables audit_logged.

tickets.name: Security team requires WAF before external launch
tickets.blurb: The security team has flagged the external API as a DDoS target after last month's incident. WAF is required before the public launch. Without it, the next DDoS attack hits your origin directly.

tickets.name: On-call rotation needs metrics before next week
tickets.blurb: The new on-call rotation starts Monday. The incoming SRE refused to take pager duty without metrics visibility. Add a metrics pipeline so the on-call can see what's happening.

tickets.name: Management requires SLA alerting
tickets.blurb: Management wants SLA tracking after the last outage went undetected for 12 minutes. The alerting node enables level-2 signals on all incidents, meaning the on-call gets paged immediately instead of hearing from customers first.

tickets.name: Failed jobs are being silently dropped
tickets.blurb: Failed background jobs are being silently dropped. Two customers reported missing webhook deliveries. The DLQ captures failures so they can be retried. Without it, every failed job is permanently lost.

tickets.name: Canary deploys required before next feature ship
tickets.blurb: Engineering has adopted canary deployments. The rollback capability is required before any canary can go to production. This is a team process gate, not a technical one.

tickets.name: TLS cert expires next sprint
tickets.blurb: The TLS certificate on tier 1 has stale_cert — it expires every sprint and is renewed manually. Tier 2 switches to managed certificate rotation: auto-renewal, no more expiry risk. Upgrade tls_cert to tier 2 before the certificate window closes.
